{{Youmay|the weapon in general|[[MZ-8 Mobile Pulse Cannon]]}}
[[File:Ig88spulsecannon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|IG-88's pulse cannon.]]

A '''pulse cannon''' was a powerful rapid fire weapon that fired a concentrated bolt of fusion [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], generally in the form of an incredibly fast moving small orb of blue or purple light.

Generally not used by military forces due to their destructive nature, a pulse cannon inflicted extreme pain on its victim, quickly causing death as the extreme heat of the bolt burned through it's victim. Due to the above average speed of the bolts, and the rate at which they could be discharged from a weapon, pulse cannons were often used to take out groups of stationary or fast moving targets.

[[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] armed his [[war-robot]]s with a removable gauntlet-mounted pulse cannon.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

[[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], carried a modified version of this weapon, as did [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]. The [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]] used by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] were sometimes referred to as a pulse cannon.

A [[phased pulse cannon]] was an especially powerful pulse cannon capable of destroying fast moving speeder bikes.<ref name="Coruscant Nights">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], large versions of these weapons were mounted on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyers]]. They were able to inflict heavy damage on ships equipped with deflector shields, and for a long time allowed it to have a devastating firepower <ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
